NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission is hereby called to be held on WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 21, 2015 at 7:00 p.m. at the Azusa Auditorium, located at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
A)
CALL TO ORDER
B)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
C)
ROLL CALL
D)
MINUTES
E)
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION - (Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes in compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or response to questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments).
F)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
1.
Third Amendment to the Monrovia Nursery Development Agreement Location: Monrovia Nursery Specific Plan area
Applicant: City of Azusa
A third development agreement amendment to extend the current Monrovia Nursery/Rosedale Development Agreement between the City of Azusa and Rosedale Land Partners II (Developer) by an additional 9 months for property generally located within the Monrovia Nursery Specific Plan area.

UPCOMING MEETING: October 28, 2015
Except as specifically provided, public hearing items are appealable to the City Council in accordance with the provisions of the City Code. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Economic and Community Development Department - Planning Division, (626) 812-5289.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35.102.104 ADA Title II).
